# Phase 5 — Talend migration and release

## Goal

Provide a migration path from Talend jobs while preparing a publishable, secure, and tested first release.

## Deliverables

- Talend file analyzer
- Intermediate model and translation layer
- Migration report generation
- Release packaging and licensing review

## Acceptance criteria

- Unsupported components are clearly identified.
- The migration report explains coverage and deviations.
- The release is installable, secure, and documented.
